scope.physical_cell: Pixel 7a face-up in the user-established near-field position over the MacBook function-key area; HVAC unknown
scope.decision_data: The already-acquired Rank 5 raw PCM and frozen strict block maps only

hypothesis: Same-session bitwise GMI and its 16-QAM AWGN-equivalent effective SINR, computed from the randomized known-QAM probe and receiver-matched actual LLRs and interpreted against the exact protocol schedule, discriminate strict block recovery better than passive stationary-noise or repeated-pilot Shannon arithmetic. The expected contrast is strongest for reverse logical output 0, for which prior descriptive arithmetic was optimistic despite 0/50 strict recovery.

inventory_policy.randomized_qam: All listed observations contain the same deterministic randomized 16-QAM rate-1/2 probe; verify TX hash before analysis.
inventory_policy.actual_llrs: Reconstruct the portable-C receiver's sync, equalization, pilot-phase fit, 25:75 global/local pilot reliability blend, and max-log LLRs in an offline Python oracle. An observation has qualified actual LLRs only if the Python decoded ordered block mask exactly matches the retained portable-C mask.
inventory_policy.noise: F0 uses the P0 Pixel two-channel passive covariance/PSD; reverse and Mac-self use the P0 Mac mono passive PSD. These are campaign-stationary noise observations, not simultaneous data-probe noise.
inventory_policy.channel_stability: Only R1/R2 provide repeat observations, and their route provenance is incomplete. F0 and S-M have one active matrix only and cannot establish stable H[k].
inventory_policy.strict_outcome: Use retained portable-C ordered block-validity masks and verify payload positions; do not infer recovery from EVM or aggregate CRC counts.

waveform_and_schedule.fec: K=7 convolutional rate 1/2 with six tail bits

calculations.passive_stationary_shannon: Split each demeaned P0 capture into nonoverlapping 2048-sample rectangular FFT records. For mono, sum_k log2(1+|h[k]|^2/N[k]) times 48000/(2048+768), flooring N[k] at max(1e-18, 1e-6 times the occupied-bin median N). For F0 scalar-input SIMO, replace the scalar ratio with h[k]^H Rn[k]^-1 h[k], loading each 2x2 Rn[k] diagonal by max(1e-18, 1e-3 times trace(Rn[k])/2). Use measured per-bin received signal power at the frozen drive; do not water-fill, extrapolate drive, or call the result achievable.
calculations.repeated_pilot_shannon: Use the stored eight-symbol repeated-pilot sum log2(1+SNR[k]) times symbol rate, unchanged and explicitly labeled descriptive.
calculations.bitwise_gmi: For each transmitted interleaved coded bit b and the corresponding actual max-log LLR L=log(P0/P1), compute max over a common s in [0,10] of 1-mean(log2(1+exp(-s*(1-2b)*L))). Report s=1 and optimized values. Optimization is part of the mismatched-decoder GMI definition, not a fitted recovery model.
calculations.effective_sinr: Invert a deterministic seed-20260718 AWGN 16-QAM max-log s=1 GMI curve made from 50000 uniformly random symbols at -10.0 through 40.0 dB in 0.25 dB steps to the observation's optimized per-bit GMI. Values outside the grid are censored, not extrapolated.
calculations.gmi_feasibility: Select the fixed probe profile only when optimized per-bit GMI is at least the exact configured coded-bit rate info_bits/capacity. Predicted fixed-profile goodput is then the 25.6 kbps schedule ceiling; otherwise it is zero. This is a preregistered finite-frame heuristic, not a capacity theorem.
calculations.incumbent_feasibility: Each Shannon incumbent selects the profile when its descriptive rate is at least 25.6 kbps. This intentionally tests the optimistic use that an adaptation layer might make of the bound.
calculations.observed_goodput: strict ordered verified payload blocks times 256 bytes times 8 divided by exactly 4.0 seconds

primary_metric.name: predictor-discrimination-against-strict-recovery
primary_metric.definition: Report Spearman rank correlation between each continuous predictor and strict block-recovery fraction across unique listed observations, with F0 MRC rows separated from mono rows to avoid double-counting in the primary all-mono comparison. Also report reverse R2 separately without fitting to it.
primary_metric.promotion_threshold: Roadmap held-out gate: median held-out goodput error <=15%; within 10% of measured-oracle profile in >=80% of held-out independent physical cells; no selection below 98% recovery when a compliant option exists; zero catastrophic selections below 90%; held-out Spearman >=0.5 and no >20% optimism.
primary_metric.stop_condition: Do not promote adaptation if there are fewer than five independent held-out physical cells spanning at least two devices or if actual-LLR mask parity fails. Publish descriptive evidence and a QUALIFICATION_GAP instead.
